cohort: The study included 166 neonates with ABO incompatibility and 28 neonates with Rhesus (D) incompatibility, delivered between 24 to 44 weeks of gestational age at Mediciti Institute of Medical Sciences.
finding: Severity of hemolysis was higher among neonates with Rh(D) incompatible setting than ABO incompatible setting, and a cord bilirubin level above 2.6mg/dl had a statistically significant association with the need for phototherapy.
mod_finding: There was no correlation between mean serum bilirubin value and the mode of delivery.
followup_time: At least until day 6 of life
